cases.expect: One journey revision references three services and may carry one end-to-end SLO without merging service identities.

cases.input: Pricing service is replaced while journey outcome and descriptive elements remain semantically unchanged.
cases.expect: A successor participation binding or journey revision records the change and prior evaluations remain pinned.

cases.input: Web and mobile channels share the same intended outcome but use separately declared observation points.
cases.expect: The journey retains one identity with explicit channel-scoped bindings or revisions.

cases.input: Pricing telemetry is missing below the declared coverage threshold but all observed attempts succeeded.
cases.expect: The journey evaluation is unknown-insufficient-coverage rather than met.

cases.input: A single service identifier is reused as the multi-service User Journey identity.
cases.expect: The merge is rejected because service and user-visible journey have independent boundaries.

cases.input: A healthy database CPU indicator is treated as proof that checkout journey SLO is met.
cases.expect: The conclusion is rejected without a declared aggregation rule and end-to-end outcome evidence.

cases.input: A mandatory identity-verification descriptive element is added without creating a successor journey revision.
cases.expect: The change is rejected because material stage and completion semantics require a new revision.
